Test program that reads a manifest file and parses it with fd_ssmanifest_parser.

# Purpose
Parses a snapshot manifest file from disk and measures the time required to decode it. The program initializes the runtime, checks that exactly one file path argument is present, and uses `stat()` and `read()` to load the full file into a workspace-backed buffer. It then allocates a `fd_snapshot_manifest_t` object and a `fd_ssmanifest_parser_t`, initializes the parser with the manifest, and calls `fd_ssmanifest_parser_consume()` to process the file contents. Command-line options `--page-sz`, `--page-cnt`, and `--numa-idx` control the temporary workspace allocation used for the parse.
